Build the hierarchy of the topics of a model

Source: R/hierarchy.R
topic_hierarchy.Rd

topic_hierarchy() clusters the topic centers of a model hierarchically, showing which topics are nearest neighbors, in what order they would merge, and at what distance. The topics of a model are not equally distinct: some lie close together in the embedding space and describe facets of one broader theme, while others stand apart. Topics that merge early, at a small distance, are near-duplicates, which suggests that the number of topics is finer than the data support.

It computes the cosine distances between the topic centers and clusters them with stats::hclust(). The result, an object of class sbert_topic_hierarchy, is deterministic. Use it to choose a smaller number of topics for reduce_topics(), or to report how the topics group into themes.

Usage

topic_hierarchy(object, method = "average")

Arguments

object

A topic model fitted by topics().

method

Agglomeration method passed to stats::hclust() (default "average").

Value

An object of class sbert_topic_hierarchy. as.data.frame() gives the merge table, one row per merge; summary() gives the nearest neighbor of every topic; plot() draws the dendrogram.

Conditions

An error of class sbert_bad_input when the model has fewer than two topics.

See also

reduce_topics() to merge topics; compare_topics() to compare numbers of topics; topic_similarity() for cosine similarities between embeddings.

Examples

corpus <- head(dedupe(feedback_translations, column = "translation"), 600)
topic_model <- topics(corpus, n_topics = 6, column = "translation",
                      embeddings = feedback_embeddings, label = "terms")
tree <- topic_hierarchy(topic_model)
tree
#> <sbert_topic_hierarchy> 6 topics, 5 merges (cosine distance)
#> 
#>  step    height                                  left
#>     1 0.2972668    topic 3 (mean / ones / strawberry)
#>     2 0.3199983 topic 1 (picture / pictures / choose)
#>     3 0.5163521                               merge 1
#>     4 0.6351317            topic 4 (box / red / blue)
#>     5 0.7383564      topic 6 (it's / person / animal)
#>                              right
#>   topic 5 (means / middle / right)
#>  topic 2 (ones / broccoli / candy)
#>                            merge 2
#>                            merge 3
#>                            merge 4
summary(tree)
#> Nearest topic of each topic (cosine distance between centers)
#> 
#>  topic                       label nearest_topic               nearest_label
#>      1 picture / pictures / choose             2     ones / broccoli / candy
#>      2     ones / broccoli / candy             1 picture / pictures / choose
#>      3    mean / ones / strawberry             5      means / middle / right
#>      4            box / red / blue             1 picture / pictures / choose
#>      5      means / middle / right             3    mean / ones / strawberry
#>      6      it's / person / animal             5      means / middle / right
#>  distance merge_step merge_height
#>     0.320          2        0.320
#>     0.320          2        0.320
#>     0.297          1        0.297
#>     0.461          4        0.635
#>     0.297          1        0.297
#>     0.538          5        0.738
